33. In our industry, industrial summons record searches are public information where Will Power have total access to. These industrial summonses can be found on many online databases and public records, readily available to those who seek them. It is obvious that such checks of public record would be performed by Will Power.

34. As for any undisclosed criminal records by Will Power to the OC, we are unaware of their nature. Again, criminal records of any companies are accessible by the public. Consequently, we have no knowledge of any of our records being withheld from the Office of the Commissioner.

35. Nonetheless, we have previously communicated with emphasis the existence of various industrial summons convictions during our meetings with the OC. In all earnestness, we have reported faithfully and with integrity all legal proceedings in all the audits which our company had involved.

36. At the time of the Fire Outbreak, we have the following large scale building maintenance and renovation works ongoing:
